# Sandy's Heating & Air

> Family-run, technician-first HVAC company serving homes across the Omaha
> metro and beyond from its Papillion, NE shop: the Omaha metro (Omaha, Papillion, La Vista,
> Gretna, Bellevue, Elkhorn), out to Fremont, Blair, Wahoo, and Plattsmouth, and
> southwest Iowa (Council Bluffs, Glenwood). Honest repair,
> installation, and maintenance — no upselling, no pressure. Open 24/7 for
> emergencies. Licensed, bonded, and insured.

Business name: Sandy's Heating & Air (Sandys HVAC LLC)
Phone: 402-213-0102
Email: Sandyshvacomaha@gmail.com
Address: 720 North Frontier Drive, Papillion, NE 68046
Service area: Omaha metro and surrounding towns in Nebraska and southwest Iowa; will travel further on request
Equipment installed: Trane, Carrier, RunTru
Service and repair: all makes and models
Certifications: Trane Comfort Specialist, BBB Accredited, Nextdoor Neighborhood Fave 2024 and 2025
